description: `store.awaiting` returns THE QUERY as well as the answer. Anyone arriving from v1 will look for an `awaiting_user` column and not find one; showing the derivation is how they learn why it is not stored (DB6) — a flag and an unanswered question can disagree, and when they do nothing says which is right.

result.sql:
SELECT 1 FROM question
WHERE component_root = ? AND loop_slug = ? AND answered_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
